name: Botswana

fees.name: Tourist Visa (TV) - embassy sticker visa
fees.validity: typically single entry, up to 3 months
fees.notes: Official Department of Immigration and Citizenship schedule (effective 1 April 2015) published by the Botswana Embassy in Brussels: Tourist Visa BWP 500 (EUR 50). Fees charged in local currency vary by mission; e.g. the Botswana Embassy in Washington DC publishes USD 30 (single entry, up to 1 month) / USD 50 (multiple entry, up to 3 months).

fees.name: e-Visa (evisa.gov.bw)
fees.validity: single entry ~1 month or multiple entry ~3 months
fees.notes: Official portal is https://evisa.gov.bw. The gov.bw tourism-visa page confirms online application (7-14 working days processing) but does not publish the fee; the fee is shown inside the portal at payment. Third-party sources report BWP 300 single-entry / BWP 500 multiple-entry, but this could not be verified on an official page, so amount is left null.

fees.name: Business Visa (BV)
fees.notes: BWP 1500 (EUR 140) per the official 2015 schedule. The Washington DC embassy lists Business Visa at USD 50 (single entry); amounts vary by mission.

fees.name: Transit Visa (TRV)
fees.validity: per travel; gov.bw also lists multiple-entry transit up to 3 months BWP 500 (~USD 50) and beyond 3 months up to 3 years BWP 1000 (~USD 100)
fees.notes: BWP 500 per travel per the official 2015 embassy schedule; gov.bw transit visa page lists BWP 500 (multiple entry up to 3 months), BWP 1000 (up to 3 years), and BWP 1500 (up to 3 years for tour operators/transporters).

vfs.note: No outsourced centre (VFS/TLS/BLS) is used for visas TO Botswana; applications go via evisa.gov.bw, Botswana immigration offices, or Botswana embassies/high commissions directly. (VFS Global centres in Gaborone handle outbound visas, e.g. to South Africa, not Botswana visas.)

free_visa_notes: Nationals of ~100 countries (incl. USA, UK, EU, most Commonwealth and SADC) enter Botswana visa-free for up to 90 days, so most tourists pay no visa fee. Diplomatic and Official visas are gratis. No visa-on-arrival or eTA regime exists; visa-required nationals must obtain an e-visa or embassy visa in advance.
